partners.mechanism_chain: GBA1 (HGNC:4114) —DECREASES→ Glucosylceramide (CHEBI:17866); Glucosylceramide (CHEBI:17866) —DISRUPTS→ Glycosphingolipid catabolism (GO:0008207); Glycosphingolipid catabolism (GO:0008207) —LEADS_TO→ Hepatomegaly (HP:0002214); CTSA (HGNC:2476) —DECREASES→ GM1 ganglioside (CHEBI:57730); GM1 ganglioside (CHEBI:57730) —DISRUPTS→ Glycosphingolipid catabolism (GO:0008207); Glycosphingolipid catabolism (GO:0008207) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250).
